name: index-bar
title: Index Bar
description: "The section index of a phone list: a column of letters at the trailing edge that jumps to a section under the finger, as the iOS section index does. Desktop lists have no index, so an index bar never renders from 768px up."
docs: Import as `import { IndexBar } from '@/components/ui/index-bar'`. See https://plexui.com/vue/components/index-bar for props and examples.
